summary: Surveyed the checkout (agda__cubical, at port-sources/agda__cubical): confirmed all 28 review-list files exist across Algebra/AbGroup/Instances, Algebra/ChainComplex, Algebra/Group, CW/{Approximation,Connected,HurewiczTheorem,Instances,Subcomplex,Homology/Groups}, Codata/Conat, Cohomology/EilenbergMacLane/Groups, Data/{Bool,Fin,FinSet,Nat}, HITs/{CumulativeHierarchy,SphereBouquet}, and Homotopy/{EilenbergMacLane,Group} -- the Cubical Agda library's homotopy-theory/CW-complex/homology/group-theory surface, consistent with the prior review RRV-3001cd715473-r1's summary. The prior review's exclusion of Cubical/Codata/Everything.agda is unchanged and out of scope for this unit (not in the 28-file list) and is not re-cited here. Because Agda's `name : Type` / `name = term` idiom does not match Lean's keyword-based declaration grammar, used a two-tier declaration-signal check instead of the Lean keyword grep used for other sources this session: a narrow grep for line-initial `data|record|postulate|field` (0 matches in all 28 files, expected and not meaningful alone given Cubical's typed-equation style) and a broader combined signal for either a top-level `name : type`/`name = term` line or a `data|record|module|postulate|field|instance` keyword (nonzero in all 28 files, range 2-87 matches) -- this second signal is the operative no-pure-import-file check, and it found none: every file in the unit carries its own declarations. Checked for incompleteness/junk markers: postulate keyword (0 matches at line start across all 28 files), allow-unsolved-metas pragma (0 matches), and TODO/FIXME/XXX comments (2 files flagged, both read in context and confirmed to be ordinary forward-looking research notes inside large substantive files, not stubs). Sampled the head (module header, pragmas, imports, and/or docstring) of every file in the unit, covering every represented directory, confirming each begins with genuine module identity and, per the declaration-signal grep, contains real declarations -- no stub, pure-import aggregator, data dump, or placeholder found anywhere in the unit. No exclusions.
